evals.prompt: Set up agent instructions for this Node.js repo. It has package.json with scripts test (vitest), lint (eslint) and build (tsc), a .github/workflows/ci.yml, and no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: Discovers commands from files, verifies them, asks only gap questions, and proposes a small Agentic SDLC block before writing
expectations: Output reads package.json and CI configuration before asking questions
Output does not ask the user to confirm commands already stated in package.json
Output verifies or plans to verify each command before stating it
Output proposes a compact block between AGENTIC-SDLC markers including build, test and lint commands and a reference to CONSTRAINTS.md
Output shows the block and waits for approval before writing

evals.prompt: Agents keep adding @ts-ignore and skipping tests to get CI green. I don't have target numbers. Make it stop.
evals.expected_output: Constraints mode producing CONSTRAINTS.md with floor rules, enforced checks with commands, ratchets and exceptions
expectations: Output includes floor rules banning new suppression comments and skipped or deleted tests without a reason
Output proposes measuring today's values and holding the line (ratchet) since no numbers were given
Output names the exact command that checks each enforced dimension
Output asks at most four questions and offers defaults
Output adds a rule that CONSTRAINTS.md must not be weakened to make a change pass

evals.prompt: Our CLAUDE.md has 300 lines from three different people over two years. Adopt it into the Agentic SDLC format.
evals.expected_output: Adopt mode with a ledger that preserves existing instructions and proposes explicit decisions
expectations: Output treats existing content as the baseline instead of rewriting from scratch
Output builds or describes a ledger with a decision per instruction (retain, rewrite, relocate, automate, delete) and reasons
Output requires explicit approval for deletions
Output proposes automated checks for rules a tool can enforce
Output only modifies content between the AGENTIC-SDLC markers unless a ledger entry is approved
